why_only_one_arm: the quality arm is blocked on human labels and on an unbalanced design, so pre-registering it would fix an analysis that cannot be run
what_is_fixed: the hypothesis and its null, with no direction taken from the pilot
the primary comparison, the test, and the alpha
the sample size and its source receipt
the exclusion rule, which explicitly forbids removing an episode for its outcome
a stopping rule with no interim looks

checks: the document exists and is frozen
once the block grows beyond the frozen episode count, the document may no longer change

failing_first_tests.mutation: add an episode while the document is unsealed

honest_limit: a preregistration written by the same agent that will run and analyse the block constrains the analysis but does not make it independent; the seal proves the document did not change, not that it was wise
